What have you learned? What are your new goals? So I write it down on a piece of paper. 2002-07-02 Make it digital Working on my website saiht.de this paper falls into my hand. That’s now 5 years ago. Maybe I should preserve it for the future. So I create a HTML table manually in Notepad and write down the events from January to December. Then I bury it in the vacation folder of the webpage, labeled “urlaub”. Datum happening 22. - 31. 12. Winterurlaub Tschechien mit Joris, Denis und Jan 1. März Volleyball in der Sportarena 12. - 16.
